en-US.name: CKB Node Monitor
en-US.summary: Monitor your CKB (Nervos Network) node stats on Echo Show devices.
en-US.description:
CKB Node Monitor displays real-time stats from your Nervos Network (CKB) node directly on your Echo Show. See block height, sync status, peer count, node version, and health status at a glance.

Node runners: set your node IP once and get personal real-time data.
Everyone else: see live public network data with a gentle nudge to run your own node.

Features:
• Live block height and sync status
• Peer count and connection health
• Node version info
• Visual healthy / syncing / offline indicator
• Tap to refresh
• Voice queries: 'Alexa, ask CKB node monitor for my block height'
en-US.whatsNew: Initial release — full dashboard for Echo Show with APL visuals.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask CKB node monitor for my block height
Alexa, ask CKB node monitor to set my node to 192.168.1.100

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Say 'Alexa, open CKB node monitor'. On Echo Show, a dashboard will appear. To set a custom node: 'Alexa, ask CKB node monitor to set my node to <IP address>'. Voice query: 'Alexa, ask CKB node monitor for my block height'.
